attempts.failure: The first Blender launch stopped on a missing closing parenthesis in the material/color zip expression.
attempts.correction: Split the zip arguments across explicit tuples and rerun the full Blender process.

attempts.failure: The purposeful low cage without a corrective shape collapsed under 72-degree flex, 18-degree splay, and 58-degree distal twist.
attempts.retained_rule: Adequate rings and weights do not guarantee volume under a combined pose; use a scoped corrective only when its pose channels are active and verify against a reference surface.

attempts.failure_prevented: A combined-pose corrective could activate during flex-only or twist-only motion and distort unrelated poses.
